name: crawlmark
description: SEO audits and monthly reports from Google Search Console, GA4, Tag Manager, DataForSEO, Ahrefs or Semrush, Lighthouse and axe-core.
long_description: Crawlmark gives Claude read access to your SEO data: Search Console and GA4 (free), PageSpeed/Lighthouse and accessibility audits, Tag Manager container audits, and optional paid keyword, ranking, competitor and backlink data from DataForSEO, Ahrefs or Semrush, using your own API key (capped by monthly budgets: dollars for DataForSEO, API units for Ahrefs and Semrush; DataForSEO's sandbox by default). Choose the default provider in the "Default SEO data provider" setting (or with `npx crawlmark-mcp setup --step provider`); each client can override it. Live SERPs, on-page checks and crawls always use DataForSEO. Everything runs locally; credentials stay on this computer. Site audits drive headless Chrome: Crawlmark uses the Chrome you already have installed (or the path in the Chrome path setting); install Google Chrome if the setup_status tool reports Chrome as missing. A Google service-account key file needs no extra step. To sign in with your own Google account instead (OAuth), run `CRAWLMARK_HOME=<data folder> npx crawlmark-mcp setup --step google` in a terminal once, then restart Claude.

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO API login
dataforseo_login.description: Optional. Enables the paid keyword, SERP and backlink tools. Usually your account email; get it at https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO API password
dataforseo_password.description: The API password generated on the API Access page. It is NOT your dashboard login password.

dataforseo_live.title: Use the live DataForSEO API (billed)
dataforseo_live.description: Off (default): the free sandbox, which returns sample data. On: real data, charged to your DataForSEO balance (capped by monthly budgets).

seo_data_provider.title: Default SEO data provider
seo_data_provider.description: dataforseo, ahrefs or semrush. Leave blank to use the value from your crawlmark .env (set by npx crawlmark-mcp setup --step provider), or dataforseo if none. Any other value is reported as an error by setup_status.

ahrefs_api_key.title: Ahrefs API key
ahrefs_api_key.description: Optional. API v3 key from Account settings > API keys (Lite plan or higher; workspace owner or admin).

semrush_api_key.title: Semrush API key (v3)
semrush_api_key.description: Optional. From Subscription info > API units. Needs an SEO Business plan and an API unit package.

semrush_v4_api_key.title: Semrush API key (v4, optional)
semrush_v4_api_key.description: Optional. From your profile > API keys. Used for the newer backlinks report; without it crawlmark uses the v3 report.

ahrefs_monthly_unit_cap.title: Ahrefs monthly unit cap
ahrefs_monthly_unit_cap.description: Optional. Ahrefs API units crawlmark may use per calendar month across all clients. Default 50,000 (each client is also capped at 10,000 unless clients.yaml sets monthlyUnits.ahrefs).

semrush_monthly_unit_cap.title: Semrush monthly unit cap
semrush_monthly_unit_cap.description: Optional. Semrush API units crawlmark may use per calendar month across all clients. Default 20,000 (each client is also capped at 5,000 unless clients.yaml sets monthlyUnits.semrush).

google_key_file.title: Google service-account key file
google_key_file.description: Optional. The JSON key of a service account that was added to your Search Console and GA4 properties. Leave empty to sign in with the OAuth client below instead.

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: Optional. Only for sign-in with your own Google account (no service account); see the extension description for the one-time sign-in step.

google_oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: Optional. The secret that goes with the OAuth client ID.

psi_api_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
psi_api_key.description: Optional. Adds real-user (field) data to Lighthouse results.

chrome_path.title: Chrome executable (optional)
chrome_path.description: Optional. The Chrome or Chromium binary used for audits. Leave empty to use the Chrome installed in its usual location; Crawlmark does not bundle one.

crawlmark_home.title: Crawlmark data folder
crawlmark_home.description: Where Crawlmark keeps its client list, cache, spend log and Google sign-in token.
